instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='view-rarible-btn', data-testid='nft-search-input', data-testid='rarity-filter-legendary', data-testid='waitlist-submit-btn').

Generate a complete 200 Gremlin dataset with deterministic SVG/Canvas procedural avatar renderers so each Gremlin #001 to #200 has distinct visual traits (Mouth spray drip, eyes, headwear like bucket hats/caps/horns, streetwear jackets, background tags).
Integrate full FastAPI + MongoDB backend for waitlist persistence and listing metadata query.
Make sure Sonner is used for toasts notifications on waitlist submissions and link copy actions.
Include an Admin view at /admin with password prompt ('hypeblock2026') to view, search, and export captured waitlist emails.
Follow dark mode cyberpunk streetwear aesthetics with high contrast neon pink, cyan, volt green, and gold accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop aesthetic - make the frontend edgy, street-art themed, interactive, and distinct.
Do not use dark colors as soft gradients; use dark obsidian surfaces (#08090D) with crisp 1px neon stroke highlights.
Do not center align the app container globally.
Provide seamless micro-animations on button hover, card lift, filter click, and modal popups.
Never use AI assistant emojis like 🤖🧠💭💡 for UI icons; use Lucide-react or Phosphor React icons.
